quests.title: The Sibling's Cache
quests.summary: Scout remembers a buried emergency supply crate cached behind their family residence before the first strike.

stages.title: Remembering the Landmark
stages.description: Consult the bunker cartography maps to pinpoint the coordinates of the old residential quadrant.

choices.label: Study old cadastral maps thoroughly
choices.description: Spend extra hours analyzing street grids to ensure safe routing.
choices.consequence_summary: High confidence in cache location; survivor morale improved.

choices.label: Rely on raw memory
choices.description: Save time and prepare gear immediately without map verification.
choices.consequence_summary: Survivor feels rushed and uneasy.

stages.title: Excavating the Basement
stages.description: Organize an expedition or allocate bunker tools to unearth the collapsed basement cache.

choices.label: Donate recovered medicine to the infirmary
choices.description: Place the salvaged antibiotics into the bunker common stores.
choices.consequence_summary: The bunker infirmary receives critical medical aid. Survivor gains 'Generous Heart'.

choices.label: Keep the family locket and private stash
choices.description: Hold on to the personal belongings as a talisman against despair.
choices.consequence_summary: Survivor achieves deep emotional peace. Survivor gains 'Unshakable Resolve'.

quests.title: The Last Confession
quests.summary: The shelter doctor is tormented by a wartime triage decision that prioritized officers over sick evacuees.

stages.title: Sleepless Nights
stages.description: The medic spends night shifts writing an unvarnished account of the checkpoint triage.

choices.label: Confide in the shelter council
choices.description: Read the written testimony aloud to fellow survivors.
choices.consequence_summary: Vulnerability builds trust and relieves psychological burden.

choices.label: Burn the testimony in the incinerator
choices.description: Destroy the pages and bury the memory forever.
choices.consequence_summary: The past is sealed, but survivor carries persistent guilt.

stages.title: Penance in the Ward
stages.description: Dedicate extensive clinical shifts to formulating antiseptic wash from basic reagents.

choices.label: Take the Oath of Triage Equality
choices.description: Swear never to prioritize rank or standing over medical urgency.
choices.consequence_summary: The medic rediscovers their vocational calling. Gains 'Righteous Triage'.

choices.label: Adopt strict utilitarian clinical detachment
choices.description: View medicine purely as an objective statistical preservation equation.
choices.consequence_summary: Medic becomes cold but remarkably efficient under trauma.

quests.title: Signals from Sector 4
quests.summary: A repeating faint carrier wave on emergency channel 14 matches an old civil defense callsign.

stages.title: Building the Pre-Amplifier
stages.description: Construct a tuned copper choke to isolate the weak signal from atmospheric static.

choices.label: Overclock RF transistor stage
choices.description: Risk burning out spare diodes to capture clear audio.
choices.consequence_summary: Audio clarifies: it is an automated looped beacon from a relay bunker.

choices.label: Filter conservatively
choices.description: Keep signal levels within safe tolerances to preserve electronics.
choices.consequence_summary: Signal is noisy but confirmed authentic.

stages.title: Decoding the Transmission
stages.description: Log the Morse code timestamps over multiple watch shifts to uncover the message payload.

choices.label: Transmit a reply pulse
choices.description: Send a short acknowledge burst into the ether.
choices.consequence_summary: A return chime acknowledges receipt. Hope ripples through the comms room.

choices.label: Maintain strict radio silence
choices.description: Log the frequency coordinates quietly without revealing shelter presence.
choices.consequence_summary: Shelter remains cloaked from raiders. Signal data archived.

quests.title: Pages of the Lost
quests.summary: An archivist seeks to reconstruct an eyewitness chronicle of the final forty-eight hours before impact.

stages.title: Gathering Witness Testimonies
stages.description: Interview elderly shelter residents regarding what they saw on the skyway on the day of sirens.

choices.label: Conduct gentle, trauma-sensitive interviews
choices.description: Take time to comfort interviewees through difficult recollections.
choices.consequence_summary: Bonds of empathy deepen among the community.

choices.label: Record exact timeline facts clinically
choices.description: Focus strictly on technical timestamps, wind direction, and shockwave delays.
choices.consequence_summary: Precise historical data captured without emotional variance.

stages.title: Binding the Volume
stages.description: Bind the collected pages into an archival volume using canvas scraps and synthetic glue.

choices.label: Place the chronicle in the common library
choices.description: Allow all survivors to read and remember their collective origins.
choices.consequence_summary: The shelter gains a shared identity. Scholar gains 'Keeper of Memory'.

choices.label: Store the volume in council security archives
choices.description: Protect the text from wear and controversial revelations.
choices.consequence_summary: Archived securely for future generations.

quests.title: The Smith's Promise
quests.summary: An engineer promised a fallen comrade to build a durable spring-loaded mobility brace for their surviving child.

stages.title: Drafting the Articulation
stages.description: Draft precision blueprints at the drafting desk using salvaged caliper measurements.

choices.label: Incorporate shock-damped titanium struts
choices.description: Design for extreme durability and heavy load carrying.
choices.consequence_summary: Heavyweight design finalized; high structural safety margins.

choices.label: Design for lightweight flexibility
choices.description: Optimize for agility and comfort across narrow ladderways.
choices.consequence_summary: Flexible design finalized; rapid walking mobility prioritized.

stages.title: Forging the Linkages
stages.description: Fabricate and temper the joint hinges at the maintenance workbench.

choices.label: Fit the finished brace with custom leather padding
choices.description: Take extra days to ensure the brace never chafes or blisters.
choices.consequence_summary: Promise fulfilled with craftsmanship. Engineer gains 'Master Artificer'.

choices.label: Stress-test the brace under heavy industrial haulage
choices.description: Verify that the brace can withstand bunker warehouse labor.
choices.consequence_summary: Brace proves indestructible. Shelter gains labor efficiency.

quests.title: Botanist's Remedy
quests.summary: A farmer attempts to isolate an edible mutant lichen whose tincture alleviates dry radiation cough.

stages.title: Cultivating the Sporebed
stages.description: Prepare moist growing medium in the hydroponic drip beds and inoculate with wild spores.

choices.label: Enrich with organic food compost
choices.description: Divert kitchen trimmings to accelerate fungal mycelium spread.
choices.consequence_summary: Lichen flourishes rapidly with sweet, earthy aroma.

choices.label: Maintain airtight glass isolation
choices.description: Prevent any risk of invasive airborne spore contamination.
choices.consequence_summary: Growth is slow but guaranteed biosecure.

stages.title: Brewing the Tincture
stages.description: Distill the harvested lichen mass using clean water and sterile glass retorts.

choices.label: Distribute cough syrup freely to all survivors
choices.description: Administer daily spoonfuls to anyone exhibiting throat irritation.
choices.consequence_summary: Coughing in the sleeping quarters subsides. Gains 'Bountiful Herbalist'.

choices.label: Refine into concentrated emergency vials
choices.description: Store high-potency drops in the trauma locker for acute cases.
choices.consequence_summary: Infirmary reserves bolstered against sudden contagion.

quests.title: The Tarnished Locket
quests.summary: A silver locket containing photographs of children lost during evacuation has suffered a broken hinge and clasp.

stages.title: Procuring Fine Wire
stages.description: Salvage delicate brass or copper wire from electronic instruments to mend the miniature hinge.

choices.label: Work under the jeweler's loupe through the night
choices.description: Carefully align the micro-pin without scratching the portraits.
choices.consequence_summary: Hinge pivots smoothly; closure snap restored.

choices.label: Ask an engineer friend for help
choices.description: Share the memory with another survivor while repairing.
choices.consequence_summary: Shared grief creates an unbreakable companionship bond.

stages.title: The Memorial Vigil
stages.description: Light a solitary tallow candle at dusk on the anniversary of the Strike.

choices.label: Dedicate the locket to protecting the living
choices.description: Vow to channel love for the lost into guarding the bunker's children.
choices.consequence_summary: Survivor transforms grief into protective purpose. Gains 'Guardian Soul'.

choices.label: Close the locket and place it in the memorial niche
choices.description: Let go of daily sorrow and lay the keepsake in the shelter wall.
choices.consequence_summary: A calm, dignified peace settles over the survivor's heart.

quests.title: Blood Debt
quests.summary: A military veteran spots a wandering drifter outside the airlock who wore the insignia of an enemy brigade.

stages.title: The Confrontation
stages.description: Observe the drifter from the watchtower slit to determine their intent and condition.

choices.label: Interrogate the stranger over the external speaker
choices.description: Demand accountability for wartime military conduct.
choices.consequence_summary: The stranger weeps: they deserted the brigade forty years ago and seek only water.

choices.label: Ready weapons and inspect perimeter seals
choices.description: Assume hostile reconnaissance and prepare defensive measures.
choices.consequence_summary: Defensive posture heightened, but tension lingers.

stages.title: Judgment at the Threshold
stages.description: Decide the stranger's fate: grant amnesty or drive them away into the wasteland.

choices.label: Offer water and grant asylum
choices.description: Break the cycle of pre-war vengeance through compassion.
choices.consequence_summary: The war truly ends in the veteran's soul. Gains 'Forgiving Veteran'.

choices.label: Order the stranger away at gunpoint
choices.description: Refuse admission to any former enemy combatant.
choices.consequence_summary: The shelter remains secure, but the shadow of war endures.

quests.title: Hymns of the Concrete
quests.summary: A former music instructor transcribes old folk melodies on salvaged scrap paper to distract frightened dwellers.

stages.title: Reconstructing the Scores
stages.description: Transcribe melodic staves from memory during maintenance lulls.

choices.label: Teach songs to the younger children
choices.description: Hold afternoon singing lessons in the mess hall.
choices.consequence_summary: Laughter and song echo down the concrete corridors.

choices.label: Arrange three-part vocal harmonies
choices.description: Organize an evening chorale for all off-duty workers.
choices.consequence_summary: Adults find solace in familiar harmonies.

stages.title: The Bunker Recital
stages.description: Stage a community performance under the warm glow of the generator bulb.

choices.label: Lead a new shelter anthem of resilience
choices.description: Unite every survivor in a chorus of enduring survival.
choices.consequence_summary: Community cohesion peaks across all shifts. Teacher gains 'Voice of Hope'.

choices.label: Conclude with a quiet evening lullaby
choices.description: Send dwellers to bed with peaceful minds.
choices.consequence_summary: Insomnia rates drop significantly. Dwellers sleep soundly.

quests.title: The Watcher's Blindspot
quests.summary: A security sentry discovers a corroded maintenance shaft that could bypass airlock barricades if breached.

stages.title: Inspecting the Conduit
stages.description: Crawl through the sub-ventilation duct to measure structural integrity and rust penetration.

choices.label: Propose welding the conduit completely shut
choices.description: Seal the shaft permanently, sacrificing secondary air circulation.
choices.consequence_summary: Breach vulnerability eliminated; slight drop in air quality.

choices.label: Rig silent alarm tripwires and keep airflow
choices.description: Preserve ventilation while establishing an early-warning trip system.
choices.consequence_summary: Air circulation preserved; defense sensors active.

stages.title: Hardening the Hatch
stages.description: Bolt heavy steel grate plates over the shaft entrance using surplus rebar.

choices.label: Take personal responsibility for night inspections
choices.description: Vow to walk the perimeter ducting at the start of every graveyard shift.
choices.consequence_summary: The bunker perimeter is impenetrable. Guard gains 'Iron Sentinel'.

choices.label: Install spring-loaded spear traps in the shaft
choices.description: Lethal automated defense ensures no infiltrator survives.
choices.consequence_summary: Lethal deterrence in place; security heightened.
